## Deferred this round — **serialised behind an in-flight card in ANOTHER lane** (`domain:cli` #18431)

<sub>`domain:services` seat (#6021) · `session_019hBqDVrwbijUCoK9qsss2E` · R1 · written 2026-09-18T21:47Z. ⛔ Report-only: no label written, no claim taken. This card keeps `pm:queue` and stays dispatchable — it is ⛔ **not** blocked, it is **sequenced**.</sub>

### Why it did not go out this fire

This card was the **top p2** by the take order (p2 + `bug` outranks the non-bug p2s), so it was next in line after the p1. It was held back by a **cross-lane file-surface collision**, which is worth recording precisely because nothing on the card itself shows it.

Triage ruled this card **one lane, deliberately not split** (`issuecomment-5731…`, verbatim: 「这是**一个机制**…… ⛔ 不是两个缺陷 ⇒ 落**一条**车道」), and warned the taker that the delivery surface spans two packages:

> ⚠️ **但请承接者知道它跨仓内两个包**:`cli/doctor.ts:708-709` 与 `:894-895` 那两处**也在交付面内**

⇒ so this card's surface reaches `packages/cli/src/commands/doctor.ts`, which belongs to the **`domain:cli`** lane. The cross-domain arm of the dispatch protocol therefore applies: the in-flight check widens from this lane to **every lane the file surface touches**.

### The collision, measured at this fire

| reading | value |
|---|---|
| board-wide `pm:dispatched` | **40** |
| `domain:cli` in flight | **2** — #18893 and #18431 |
| **#18431**'s declared file surface (from its claim comment, 2026-09-18T05:36:42Z) | ⭐ **`packages/cli/src/`**, `packages/lint/src/`, `packages/spec/src/`, `packages/cli/test/` (new files only) |
| #18893's declared file surface | `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx` ⇒ **disjoint** |

⇒ **#18431 declares `packages/cli/src/` at region level, and this card's two `doctor.ts` sites sit inside it.**

### ⛔ Why "probably disjoint" was not good enough

#18431 is a per-package docs collector under an ADR-0130 layout; on its subject matter it is ⛔ **unlikely** to touch `doctor.ts`. That is exactly the judgement the rule refuses to let a seat make: a claim declared **to region level** is the unit that counts, and the standing instruction is 「**认领申报文件面到区域级,拿不准就串行**」. This seat cannot tell from outside whether the collector reaches `doctor.ts` ⇒ **serial**.

⚠️ ⛔ File-surface disjointness would only have bought textual mergeability anyway; it never proves semantic independence. Here it does not even buy that.

### Release condition — mechanical, ⛔ no judgement needed at pickup

Dispatch this card once **either** holds:

1. **#18431's PR has landed** (it is `pm:dispatched` + `needs:contract-review` + p3, so it also owes a contract-review-tier review before it can land — expect latency), **or**
2. **#18431's actual diff is measured not to touch `packages/cli/src/commands/doctor.ts`** — a PR `get_files` reading, ⛔ not a reading of its claim comment or its card text.

⇒ route 2 is cheap and available the moment #18431 opens a PR. ⭐ **Prefer it** — waiting for a p3 in another lane to clear contract review would strand a p2 `bug` for no measured reason.

### What this seat did NOT establish

⛔ Whether any of the four propagating sites is reachable from an authored document today. The card's own **Evidence limit** section says the same and this fire added nothing to it. ⇒ the p2 grade and triage's stated escalation condition (a measured `'[object Object]'` in stored data ⇒ p1) both stand untouched.

Same package, different file, in both cases. The `plugin-approvals` hit in the anchor is an **H52** row (an `os-dev-report` carrying non-empty `open_questions` on #11286), ⛔ not an H17 trigger file.

**Own-lane serial constraints**: this seat's three in-flight cards hold `plugin-webhooks/`, `service-messaging/` and `plugin-security/` + `plugin-audit/`. ⛔ Disjoint from all three paths here. Hot-file serial queue carries no row for them. `os-verify-lock.sh --status` at claim time: holder is this seat's own #18412 build, **queue empty** ⇒ arrival depth 1, below `LOCK_DEPTH_HOLD` (2).

**取卡前置 re-read at THIS card-taking, ⛔ not carried from the round's first batch**: open `priority:p0` = **4**, `priority:p1` = **43** ⇒ North Star clause 3 is LIVE. It does ⛔ not bar this card: #19081 is a `bug`-typed product-facing defect — one site stringifies an unreadable carrier into the literal target name `'[object Object]'`, which **manufactures a wrong answer** rather than losing information. It is ⛔ not a 工具卡 and ⛔ not a 契约卫生卡.

⚠️ `Clause-②: no`: narrowing four truthiness gates to the `typeof … === 'string'` shape the same file already uses at `doctor.ts:792` **pulls back to the declared contract** (`FieldSchema.reference` is declared an optional string) — 拉回已声明契约, which does ⛔ not reach clause ②.</sub>

### Checklist — read off the PR

| item | reading |
|---|---|
| PR shape | `draft: true`, base `main`, body line 1 is `Fixes #19081` ✅ |
| changed files | **7**, `+361/-14` ✅ |
| Clause-② path limb | ⛔ zero `packages/spec/**` ✅ |
| **R3 cross-lane confinement** | `packages/cli` files in the diff: **`commands/doctor.ts` and its test, and nothing else** ✅ |
| lane red lines | zero `packages/spec`, zero `content/docs/releases/**`, zero governed surface ✅ |
| changeset | present, `patch` for the three published packages ✅ |
| `mcp_calls` | **0**; `api_writes` 2, exactly the budget; zero label and zero assignee writes ✅ |

### ⭐ The design fork was decided by measurement, which is what the dispatch asked for

Zone 3 left the local-narrowing vs arbiter question open **and required a reading before choosing**. The dev took one that changes the answer: `referenceCarrierOf` does ⛔ **not** return the same narrowing — it **THROWS** a `TypeError` on a non-string carrier (`field-value.zod.ts:241-252`) and additionally maps `''` → `undefined`.

⇒ it chose *both*: read through the one arbiter (so there is no fourth hand-copy of the carrier semantics) **and catch the refusal at the site**, yielding absence plus one report. The justification is site-specific and correct on my reading of the diff: an escaping throw is hostile at all four — approvals' `resolveLookupFields` sits inside a `try/catch` returning `[]`, so one bad field would drop **every** lookup field of the object; analytics runs inside dataset compilation, where a `TypeError` would replace the compiler's own refusal; and `doctor` would abort the diagnostic run on exactly the broken metadata it exists to report.

### Both deviations verified, ⛔ not accepted on the report's word

1. ✅ **`detectCircularDependencies` gained `export` — no published surface is added.** Checked at source: `packages/cli` declares `files: ["dist","README.md","CHANGELOG.md"]` and its `exports` map is `.`, `./console`, `./hook-body`, `./package.json` — **`doctor` appears in none of them**. The export exists so the pin can assert the carrier reading, and `doctor` remains the only caller.
2. ✅ **Reporting the unreadable carrier instead of silently skipping is the right call, for the reason the code states.** Both `doctor` checks make **positive** claims — "No circular references detected" and "defined but not referenced by any view, flow, app, or lookup field". A silently missing edge cannot support either. ⇒ surfacing it into the `string[]` each check already returns is the loud half, and it adds ⛔ no new channel: `doctor` already prints those arrays as warnings.

⚠️ Neither reaches clause ②: an internal function of a module the package does not publish gains an `export`, and what widens is what those functions **return**, ⛔ not what any surface **accepts**. `Clause-②: no` stands.

### ⭐ A premise was FALSIFIED, and that is a good outcome

**A6 does not hold** as the card states it. `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` now carries **4 production `referenceCarrierOf` hits**, landed by #19080 **after** the card's ref `221dabb72`. The card's census — "none of these production paths routes through the arbiter" — is therefore **stale for `packages/objectql`**. Inside this PR's own three packages the zero still stands (sole hit is `packages/cli/test/data-model-rules.test.ts`), with a live control: the token resolves in 20 files repo-wide.

⇒ recorded as a **measurement update, ⛔ not a defect**, and exactly what the dispatch meant by "falsifying one is a GOOD outcome". ⚠️ The four sites had also drifted **+3 lines** from the card's ref; the dev re-located them by construct rather than editing the card's line numbers, which is why nothing was edited in the wrong place.

### Findings — one filed by this seat, two correctly left noted

- 🔴 **Filed as #19198** (class **b**, contradicts a declared contract). ⭐ The cited contract was re-read verbatim on `origin/main` **by this seat** before filing, ⛔ not taken from the report: `IMPLICIT_REFERENCE_TARGETS`' docblock states the `user` target is a **CONSTANT OF THE TYPE** and that metadata authored without `reference` is 「fully specified, not under-specified」 — while `resolveLookupFields` requires an explicit one, so such a field is invisible to inbox enrichment. ⭐ The dev **stopped and reported instead of fixing it**, which was correct: routing to `referenceTargetOf` would widen the accept set, and 回翻条款 says report rather than silently re-rule.
- ✅ Two `noted, not filed` entries (the bare-`typeof` contrast site at `doctor.ts:795`, and the stale A6 census) are correctly outside the three filing classes.

### ⚠️ Gates — a platform fact this round did not previously have

`64 derived, 60 run, 4 NOT MEASURED (exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET), 0 UNRUN`. Two of the four — **`check:i18n-coverage` and `check:i18n-walk-parity`** — are ⛔ **NOT** on the known-broken list this seat has been handing to devs, which so far named only `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n` and `check:type-check-debt`. ⇒ the list is now five, and it is going onto the seat post so the next dispatch does not present a partial one as complete. ⛔ None is read as a pass; all are declared to CI.

Latest-run-per-check-name at `1130dc81b7`: **15 success · 3 skipped · 13 `in_progress` · 0 failure**. ⇒ stays **draft** and ⛔ out of the queue until every check is green or an expected skip. ⚠️ This round has already produced one PR whose red only appeared after the `in_progress` tail resolved (#19194), so the hold is ⛔ not a formality.
